transactions.citation: AR p48 (per prior extraction): 8-asset non-core industrial portfolio divestment announced 15 December 2025, aggregate consideration S$338.1m, '2.0% above valuation'; per-property sale price for this asset S$42.2m, independent valuation (31 Dec 2025) S$41,409k [note: carrying value column; property-level valuation column for this asset used to build the S$331.6m deal aggregate below].
transactions.notes: AGGREGATE DEAL per SPEC: this row is one of 8 properties (86 & 88 International Road, 120 Pioneer Road, 13 Jalan Terusan, 60 Tuas South Street 1, 43 Tuas View Circuit, 21 & 23 Ubi Road 1, 24 Jurong Port Road, 46A Tanjong Penjuru) sold together in one 15-Dec-2025-announced non-core industrial portfolio divestment for an aggregate S$338.1m at a disclosed AGGREGATE 2.0% premium to valuation. Per SPEC's aggregate-deal rule, ALL EIGHT property rows share this SAME deal_id and repeat the SAME deal-level reference_value (S$331,600,000 = the sum of the 8 properties' individually-disclosed independent-valuation figures: 41,409+33,440+16,383+3,410+14,814+42,500+66,792+111,498 -- NOTE: for 21/23 Ubi Road 1 and 46A Tanjong Penjuru the individually disclosed 'valuation' figures used in this sum are S$42,500k and S$109,500k respectively per the prior per-property extraction, which differ slightly from the Portfolio Statement audited independent-valuation column figures of S$41,700k/S$111,498k for those two rows -- both figures are recorded per-property below; the S$331.6m aggregate uses the AR's own per-property 'valuation' figures consistent with the 2.0% aggregate check: 338.1/331.6=1.0196=~2.0%, reconciling) and the SAME deal-level gain_loss_pct=2.0% (disclosed). No per-property premium is separately disclosed -- the 2.0% is only ever stated in aggregate, so it is NOT re-derived per property. This property's individual sale price: S$42,200,000 SGD; individual carrying value: S$41,409,000 SGD (audited Portfolio Statement, held-for-divestment column) -- recorded here for reference but the row's populated gain_loss_pct/reference_value are the deal-level (aggregate) figures per SPEC, not property-level derivations.
